import pandas as pd

def main():
    # Define source file paths
    source_files = [
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_36/test_0.csv",
        "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_36/test_1.csv"
    ]

    # Define the target schema columns and their types for explicit casting later
    target_columns = [
        'tripduration', 'starttime', 'stoptime', 'start station id', 'start station name',
        'start station latitude', 'start station longitude', 'end station id', 'end station name',
        'end station latitude', 'end station longitude', 'bikeid', 'usertype', 'birth year', 'gender'
    ]

    # Data types for casting to ensure conformity with target schema
    dtype_map = {
        'tripduration': 'int64',
        'starttime': 'string',
        'stoptime': 'string',
        'start station id': 'Int64',  # Nullable integer
        'start station name': 'string',
        'start station latitude': 'float64',
        'start station longitude': 'float64',
        'end station id': 'Int64',    # Nullable integer
        'end station name': 'string',
        'end station latitude': 'float64',
        'end station longitude': 'float64',
        'bikeid': 'Int64',            # Nullable integer
        'usertype': 'string',
        'birth year': 'Int64',        # Nullable integer
        'gender': 'Int64'             # Nullable integer
    }

    # Load all source dataframes into a list
    dfs = []
    for file_path in source_files:
        df = pd.read_csv(file_path, dtype=str)  # Read all as string first to avoid dtype issues
        dfs.append(df)

    # Concatenate all source dataframes vertically (union)
    combined_df = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

    # Convert columns to appropriate types according to target schema
    # First, strip whitespace from column names to avoid issues
    combined_df.columns = combined_df.columns.str.strip()

    # Convert columns to target types
    for col, dtype in dtype_map.items():
        if col in combined_df.columns:
            if dtype == 'string':
                combined_df[col] = combined_df[col].astype('string')
            elif dtype == 'Int64':
                # Nullable integer conversion: convert to numeric then to Int64
                combined_df[col] = pd.to_numeric(combined_df[col], errors='coerce').astype('Int64')
            elif dtype == 'int64':
                combined_df[col] = pd.to_numeric(combined_df[col], errors='coerce').fillna(0).astype('int64')
            elif dtype == 'float64':
                combined_df[col] = pd.to_numeric(combined_df[col], errors='coerce').astype('float64')

    # Reorder columns to match target schema exactly
    combined_df = combined_df[target_columns]

    # Save the combined and transformed dataframe to the target CSV file
    output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_36/target_multisource_cot.csv"
    combined_df.to_csv(output_path, index=False)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
